description: Declared net quantity, when compared against the actual measured quantity, falls within the First Schedule's maximum permissible error for its declared-quantity band.
source_citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6(1)(c) read with First Schedule, Table I
implementation_note: This rule needs a measured/verified net quantity, not just the value printed on the label -- the project explicitly does not physically re-weigh packages (see PRD Out of Scope). It can only be evaluated where a ground-truth measured quantity is supplied separately, e.g. during dataset annotation. It cannot run on OCR-extracted label text alone in production, and should be documented as a plausibility/format check rather than a genuine physical-quantity verification.
